test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the give statements and conclusions carefully. Decide which of the given conclusion(s) follow(s) based on the given statements.

**Statement:**

M ≤ N B

II. C > M

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both the conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Given: **M ≤ N A ≥ B N ≥ M

**Explanation:**

I. N > B → False ( as N B → a definite relation between N and B cannot be determined))

II. C > M → True ( as C = O > N ≥ M is defined relation between C and M)

Hence, **Only conclusion II follows****.**
